# Example historical gap to investigate

Use this pattern when a timeline moment is underrepresented.

## Candidate theme

- ma’abarot absorption pressures after independence

## What to check

- existing event coverage in `content/events/`
- cabinet-level response patterns
- source-backed records for housing, migration, and security pressure
- whether the event belongs in a soft or hard window

## Good output

- a new event file in `content/events/`
- a source-backed `title`, `text`, and option logic
- a `status: draft` entry until a person has checked every claim against its source, then `fact-checked`
- a clear relation to the broader state-building story
